jobs.title: Administrative Aide IV (Clerk II)
jobs.assignment: Comptrollership Financial Management Section - Cotabato City District Engineering Office
jobs.eligibility: Career Service (Sub Professional First Level Eligibility
jobs.education: Completion of 2 years Studies in College
jobs.description:
- Assist in the preparation of payrolls and other personnel benefits of the officils and employees of the District.
- Assist in the preparation of the needed documents for appointment of both regular and job order personnel.
- Maintain and updates personnel files.
- Performs such other functions as maybe directed by immediate supervisor.
jobs.howToApply:
Interested and qualified applicants should signify their interest in writing. Attach the following documents to the application letter and submit through the Bangsamoro Job Portal not later than indicated deadline of submission.
Documents:
1. Fully accomplished Personal Data Sheet (PDS) with recent passport-sized picture and Work Experience Sheet (CS Form No. 212, Revised 2017) which can be downloaded at www.csc.gov.ph;
2. Performance rating in the last rating period (if applicable);
3. Photocopy of certificate of eligibility/rating/license; and
4. Photocopy of Transcript of Records.
QUALIFIED APPLICANTS are advised to address their application to:
ARCH'T EDUARD U. GUERRA
Minister
Ministry of Public Works
BGC Compound, Cotabato City
applications@mpw.bangsamoro.gov.ph
APPLICATIONS WITH INCOMPLETE DOCUMENTS SHALL NOT BE ENTERTAINED.
